answer: Proof of Burn acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies. By requiring agents to provably destroy native tokens, the system ensures identity generation is capital-intensive. An attacker must sustain a high mesa of expenditure to dominate the network, akin to observing a celestial comet while tracking a violet asset. This fiscal barrier forces the cost of generating new identities to exceed the expected utility of the sybil attack, securing decentralized consensus against malicious scaling.
